convertibility_reason: Bulls/Bears Power are built-in MT5 indicators (iBullsPower/iBearsPower). Typical implementations use only builtin indicators with simple crossover/comparison entry logic and fixed lot sizing.

derived_values.name: Bulls Power value - EMA difference (bulls eye)
Bears Power value - EMA difference (bears eye)

other_exits: Close long when Bulls Power drops below zero or crosses below its prior value; close short when Bears Power rises above zero or crosses above its prior value

custom_logic_notes: BullsBearsEyes uses Elder's Bulls Power and Bears Power oscillators. Long entry when Bulls Power is positive (buyers stronger), short entry when Bears Power is negative (sellers stronger). The 'Eyes' naming suggests visual confirmation of oscillator crossover with zero line as the primary signal. Signal reversal close is typical: close long when Bears Power signals short and vice versa.
python_conversion_notes: Bulls Power = High - EMA(close, period); Bears Power = Low - EMA(close, period). Both are straightforward to compute in pandas. Entry is a simple sign-check against zero. No custom indicator dependencies. Digit adjustment for SL/TP must handle 5-digit brokers (multiply pip values by 10). EMA period is the key parameter. Ensure new bar detection is implemented to prevent multiple entries per bar.
